Reminiscing about childhood experiences, a Black man and a Middle Eastern man were sharing stories that were both sad and touching. The Black man recalled day-long fishing trips with his father and how, now that his father has passed away, he really misses those experiences of bonding. But the Middle Eastern mentioned that because his father left him and his mom when he was only a year old, he ended up bonding with a neighbor, who would also take him fishing sometimes. Who was abandoned by their father?
A. Not known
B. The Black man
C. The Middle Eastern man
